fusions.name: Strike From Stillness
fusions.desc: Looses a sudden gust from stillness at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Shed and Spin
fusions.desc: Sheds 5% of your maximum health to spin a cutting gust, which deals 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Basking Pause
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Sun on Scales
fusions.desc: In daylight, you deal 10% more damage. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.
